desc.testo: Ameren Corporation is an American power company created December 31, 1997, by the merger of Union Electric Company of St. Louis, Missouri and the neighboring Central Illinois Public Service Company of Springfield, Illinois. It is now a holding company for several power companies and energy companies. The company is based in St.
